Must eat in Can Tho
Sep 2026 • Solo
I wanted to eat at the Mekong Restaurant first, but because there was a buffet there, I was sent to Saravan on the 6th floor, a Vietnamese-Thai Fusion restaurant. The cocktails were top-notch and the crab with glass noodles were ridiculously delicious! The mango sticky rice as dessert was just enough, and the chef also gave me an extra dessert, Thai tea panna cotta. 

Above all, the service from Nguyen was excellent. Her English was not only very good; she was friendly, helpful, gave advice, and very interested and not in an annoying way. Had a very cozy chat!

Saravan Review
Aug 2026 • Family
Had dinner at Saravan with my family and really enjoyed the experience. The staff were friendly and attentive, especially Henry and Nguyen.

I had a bit of a cough during the meal, and they kindly brought me some hot ginger tea. It was a small gesture, but I really appreciated their thoughtfulness.

Overall, we had a nice time here. Good service and a warm atmosphere. Definitely a place I’d come back to.
